title: 3D human motion correction via learning from physically simulated data (working title)
contribution: First author. 3D human motion reconstructed from monocular video exhibits systematic artifacts: penetration, floating, foot skating. I train a correction model on a paired clean ↔ degraded corpus that I build by rendering and then re-estimating motion, in which physics is used solely as training data — neither in the loss function nor in the architecture. Work carried out at the University of Alberta's Vision & Learning Lab (Prof. Li Cheng).
